_comment: Golden reference for the ORIGINAL Shadow Fight 2 frame timing.
Captured live from the ARM binary on Redmi 6A / Android 9 via
Loop: game+0x64400. See reverse/analysis/RUNTIME_MAP.md section 5 and
Every value here was read out of the live process or decoded from the
relocated image -- none of it is inferred from the JS port.

frame_interval._how: read live from the loop object at this+0x08 (LDRD r4,r5,[r8,#8])
frame_interval._note: 1000/60 = 16.666 truncated to 16, so the real cap is 62.5 fps
frame_interval._xml_note: internalSettings.xml says <FrameRate Value="60"/>; that is nominal, the loop period is 16ms

delta_conversion._how: vcvt.f64.f32 then vdiv.f64 by a literal at 0x8F0BB2B0
delta_conversion._note: delta is integer milliseconds / 1000.0 as double, so dt is quantised to 1ms
delta_conversion._forbidden_note: a float 1/60 accumulator produces values the original can never emit

step_state_object._note: four doubles are written per frame, all in seconds
step_state_object._gap: reSF2 passes a single float dt; three values are dropped (GAP-2)

wait_loop._note: no fractional remainder is carried between frames -- not an accumulator

quit_requested._note: if ctx->[0x34] != 0 the quit is deferred: calls game+0x14870 and resumes at +0x644B0
